thread:
Tariq A.: hey folks, quick question for my first week: where do i post questions about getting model access, dataset approvals, or anything that might need legal/privacy review? also how should i surface evals/benchmark questions so they don't get lost in #eng?

Marta P.: welcome! :wave: short map for that special case: model access & credentials -> @Infra Ops in #help-it (include your org + workspace). dataset approvals, PII questions, or anything privacy-related -> @Data Privacy in #privacy or DM them for sensitive details. legal/contract stuff -> @Legal Bot or #legal.

Marta P.: for evals/benchmarks, post in #eng-ml with a short subject and a link to your eval artifacts (not raw data). If it affects product metrics, also ping #product with "tag: eval" so PMs see it.

Onboarding Bot: Hi Tariq! :sparkles: For Day-1: run `/onboard join` to get the checklist. To stop tips: DM me `unsubscribe` or run `/onboard snooze 7d`. To get pinned resources: `/pins #new-hires`.

Tariq A.: good to know. for dataset approvals, do we have a form or a repo with the approval workflow?

Data Privacy: yes  we have a request form in Confluence (link pinned in #privacy). Best practice: create a short ticket that includes dataset source, fields, retention, and intended use. Minimal template: 

Data Privacy: ```
Dataset: internal-logs-v2
Source: infra logs (prod)
Fields: timestamp, request_id, user_id* (hashed)
Retention: 90 days
Purpose: eval model X for latency
```

Data Privacy: mark the ticket with "sensitivity: PII" if any identifiables might exist. We'll review and advise redaction or legal sign-off.

Tariq A.: thanks. and model access (internally hosted models)  what's typical lead time? who grants it?

Infra Ops: model access depends on the environment: hosted API tokens are immediate via the Console; for Dedicated or Private deployments we need an access request and an IAM role. Typical lead time for IAM changes: 1-3 business days. To request, tag `@Infra Ops` and include: environment (hosted/dedicated/private), model name, reason, and your team alias. Example: 

Infra Ops: ```
Request: model-access
Env: dedicated-us-west
Model: open-llama-3b-quant
Team: infra-research
Reason: eval for cost/perf tradeoffs
```

Marta P.: also note that some models require an additional security review if they use customer data. When in doubt, put the request in #privacy and we'll route it.

Tariq A.: perfect. last q: i want to ask about eval infra and who covers cost for large eval runs. where's the right place?

Marta P.: cost/chargebacks -> #finance or tag `@Finance Bot` with a short cost estimate. For cluster requests or large GPU runs, include estimated GPU-hours and dataset size; Infra will advise and product/finance may approve. Example cost note: 

Marta P.: ```
Run: eval-suite-aug
GPU: 8x A100-80GB for 6 hours = 48 GPU-hours
Data: 200 GB
Estimate: ~ $X
Owner: infra-research
```

Legal Bot: automated: hi! for anything involving third-party data or vendor models, please DM `legal review` with the request link. We triage SLA/DPAs and let you know if a contract amendment is needed.

Tariq A.: thanks everyone  this helps a lot. one more small thing: if i post an eval in #eng-ml, what's the preferred thread style so others can reproduce?

Marta P.: tidy thread template: 1) subject line e.g. "Eval: quantization perf on llama-3b", 2) short summary (goal, main result), 3) commands + env in a code block, 4) link to artifacts and cost estimate, 5) ask (e.g., "feedback on kernel choice?"). That makes it easy to triage.

Tariq A.: got it. i'll post the first eval tomorrow and CC infra/privacy if needed. appreciate the quick map! :thumbsup:
